supereo_haptics.name: Supereo Haptics
supereo_haptics.description: Native mobile feedback with honest capabilities, portable custom patterns and a visible preview simulation.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.desc: Initial player preference. Disabling cancels addon work; semantic feedback already submitted to the operating system may not be cancellable.

strength.name: Overall strength
strength.desc: Initial strength from 0 to 1: 0 is silent, 0.35 is Light, 1 is Normal. Some native semantic effects only offer discrete strengths.

native-required.name: Native required
native-required.desc: Keep enabled for Android and iOS exports. A missing native bridge produces an explicit error. Disable only to opt into a clearly labeled visual simulation.

preview-simulation.name: Preview simulation
preview-simulation.desc: When Native required is disabled and no native bridge is available, show requested feedback and pattern timing visually. No hardware is exercised. Native required always takes priority.

overlap.name: Overlap policy
overlap.desc: Replace drops the active addon pattern; Ignore skips new requests while the previous estimated scheduling window is active.

duplicate-window-ms.name: Duplicate protection (ms)
duplicate-window-ms.desc: Suppress identical rapidly repeated feedback within this interval, from 0 to 1000 ms. Default 40 ms helps avoid duplicate event triggers.

bridge-wait-ms.name: Bridge wait limit (ms)
bridge-wait-ms.desc: Maximum initial native readiness wait, from 250 to 10000 ms. Default 2500 ms prevents a missing bridge from blocking startup indefinitely.

is-ready.description: The initial bounded capability check has finished, including unavailable backends.

is-enabled.description: Check the explicit player haptics setting.

native-bridge-available.description: The Cordova native bridge was found; use Haptic hardware available to check the device.

haptic-hardware-available.description: The native platform reports appropriate vibration or haptic hardware. It does not promise every requested effect will play.

intensity-control-supported.description: Hardware and backend support meaningful variable intensity; semantic feedback may still use discrete strengths.

advanced-patterns-supported.description: A native backend can schedule custom patterns. Consult CapabilitiesJSON for its exact curve, sharpness, primitive and envelope features.

sharpness-control-supported.description: The backend supports a sharpness parameter. Android does not generally provide Core Haptics-equivalent sharpness control.

primitives-supported.description: The Android device reports composition support for relevant native primitives. Exact supported primitives are listed in CapabilitiesJSON.

envelopes-supported.description: The guarded Android envelope API and matching hardware capability are available.

is-preview-simulation.description: Requests are displayed visually; no native hardware is being exercised.

on-accepted.description: A play request was accepted locally by the native backend or visible simulation. This is not a physical completion callback.

on-rejected.description: A play request was skipped, disabled, duplicated, busy, backgrounded or failed. Read LastResultJSON for the reason.

on-error.description: A structured validation, missing native bridge or backend error occurred. Read LastError and LastResultJSON.

on-preview.description: A feedback request was shown by the visual simulation. No native device was tested.

on-capabilities-refreshed.description: The Refresh capabilities action finished. Check LastError if the native query failed.

play-feedback.description: Request native selection, impact or notification feedback. Acceptance does not prove that the hardware produced a sensation.

feedback.name: Feedback
feedback.desc: Choose the feel or meaning of this gameplay moment. Device settings and hardware affect the sensation.

stop.description: Cancel this addon's active pattern and pending requests. UIKit semantic feedback may already have been handed to the operating system.

set-enabled.description: Apply the player's haptics preference. Disabling immediately drops this addon's active work.

enabled.name: Haptics
enabled.desc: Choose Disabled for players who prefer no feedback.

set-strength.description: Set the overall strength from 0 to 1. Strength changes drop the active pattern and apply to future requests; discrete native effects may use coarser fallback choices.

strength.name: Strength
strength.desc: 0 is silent, 0.35 is a useful Light setting, and 1 is Normal. Must be from 0 to 1.

register-pattern.description: Validate and store a version 1 portable pattern. Register up to 64 names at layout start; ordinary Play feedback actions do not need JSON.

name.name: Pattern name
name.desc: A name with 1 to 80 characters, used later by Play custom pattern.

json.name: Pattern JSON
json.desc: Version 1 JSON containing bounded transient taps and continuous events. See the custom-pattern documentation.

play-pattern.description: Play a registered custom pattern by name. The backend reports approximations in LastResultJSON.

name.name: Pattern name
name.desc: Use the exact name registered with Register custom pattern.

set-overlap-policy.description: Replace cancels the addon's previous pattern; Ignore keeps it and rejects new requests during its estimated scheduling window. This window is not hardware completion.

policy.name: Policy
policy.desc: Use Replace for immediate game interactions, or Ignore for sequences that should finish.

refresh-capabilities.description: Read actual native capabilities again and trigger On capabilities refreshed. Useful after returning to the foreground.

backend.description: Current native backend, preview-simulation, initializing or unavailable.

fallback-info.description: Human-readable capability and fallback information for this device.

capabilities-json.description: Structured native capability flags and any per-effect or per-primitive support details.

last-result-json.description: Structured dispatch acceptance, request ID, approximation, fallback, reason and completion visibility. Acceptance is not proof of physical feedback.

last-error.description: The last structured error message, or an empty string after a successful result.

last-request-id.description: The identifier associated with the most recent response.

last-feedback.description: The last requested preset or registered custom-pattern name.

last-was-approximated.description: 1 if the last dispatched effect used an approximation; otherwise 0.
